text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi Baath party delegation arrives in Cairo to attend Arab parties and organisations conference.
- The Iraqi-Jordanian land transport company participates in bringing food and medicine brought by Iraq under its oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
- Editorial wishing that newly appointed U.N. Special Commission chief Richard Butler to open new page with Iraq.
(The above stories except the editorial were carried by JUMHOURIYA and QADISSIYA)
- Iraq receives more trade offers by various world companies to sell goods under its oil deal with the U.N.
- Editorial urging France, China and Russia to set up an arbitration committee between Iraq and the Special Commission.
